views.center: center crop 128 of the raw 800x600 front image (no scaling)
views.lidar: upstream BEV histogram (224x224, sum of the two height bins, 95th-percentile normalised) re-oriented for the figure: forward up, ego at bottom centre, left on the left; rendered metric (57 m lateral x 28 m forward, 16 px/m). The model's native array is 224x224 with 0.254 m/row lateral and 0.125 m/col forward.
